config.extendedbeaconrange.title: Extended Beacon Range Settings
config.extendedbeaconrange.colorVisualPe: Assign a color to each beacon perimeter. When disabled, all perimeters are white. Changes apply immediately.
config.extendedbeaconrange.colorMatchBea: Use the color of the beam's top section, including mixed stained glass colors. Without stained glass, the perimeter is white. When disabled, colors are assigned by beacon position. Requires colored perimeters. Changes apply when the beam updates; the beam itself is unchanged.
config.extendedbeaconrange.showEffectTim: Show the remaining time below beacon-effect icons in the HUD. Timers are hidden while a nearby beacon maintains the current effect level. The border countdown and effect levels are always shown. Inventory effects are unchanged.
config.extendedbeaconrange.save_failed.d: Changes apply for this session but could not be saved. Check that config/extendedbeaconrange-client.json is valid and writable, then restart the game. The existing file has been preserved.
